decisions.reason: As a close extension of the existing modular sensing platform, it likely has low incremental support costs and management would tolerate some early uncertainty unless sales clearly fall below aspiration.

This industrial input module builds directly on the firm’s established automation offer and dedicated presentation suggests commitment, so it is likely to be retained while market feedback accumulates.

A solid state relay module fits the firm’s core control and automation architecture, making it a plausible complementary product that management would keep unless performance shows a clear persistent shortfall.

The server room monitoring kit is somewhat more solution-specific than the core building blocks, but because it reuses existing hardware and software capabilities the firm likely keeps it for another year before judging it against aspiration levels.
